Burnham became Prime Minister following Keir Starmer's resignation and is not legally required to call an election before the next scheduled vote in 2029. articles.title: ‘FBI, CIA’s 9/11-Like Lapse...’: Top Dem Drops Bombshell Report During US House Hearing | Watch
articles.description: A heated House Intelligence Committee hearing on America's counterterrorism strategy turned political after a top Democratic lawmaker warned of a potential "9/11-like intelligence lapse," raising concerns about whether the U.S. is prepared to detect and prevent emerging threats.The hearing, held nearly 25 years after the September 11 terrorist attacks, examined how the nation's intelligence and counterterrorism agencies—including the FBI, CIA, and the broader intelligence community—have adapted to evolving security challenges such as artificial intelligence, domestic extremism, and transnational terrorism.
